items.title: NASA and IBM Launch Lunar AI Model, Space Brief 13 Sep 2026
items.summary: NASA and IBM have released a new AI model designed for lunar research.

items.title: NASA, IBM launch open-source lunar foundation AI model to help map ice, craters on moon
items.summary: IBM and NASA release an open-source lunar AI foundation model to map craters, analyze volcanic features, and identify potential ice deposits In recent space technology innovation, IBM and NASA have officially released open-source AI model designed to help scientists analyze decades of lunar observation data and support plans for a sustained human presence on the Moon.
